name: Egg Festival
description: Egg hunt in the town square; Pierre sells Strawberry Seeds.

name: Desert Festival
description: Three-day festival in the Calico Desert with villager shops and Calico Eggs. Requires the bus.

name: Flower Dance
description: Dance in the forest clearing; you need 4 hearts to ask a partner.

name: Luau
description: Add an item to the communal soup at the beach.

name: Trout Derby
description: Fishing mini-festival by the forest river: Rainbow Trout can be caught all day in any weather.

name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
description: Watch the jellies from the docks at night.

name: Stardew Valley Fair
description: Grange display, games and Star Tokens in town.

name: Spirit's Eve
description: A spooky night maze in town; the Golden Pumpkin is at the end.

name: Festival of Ice
description: Ice fishing contest in Cindersap Forest.

name: SquidFest
description: Squid can be caught all day at the beach; prize tiers each day.

name: Night Market
description: Boats at the beach docks, the deep-sea submarine ride and the Traveling Cart.

name: Feast of the Winter Star
description: Secret gift exchange in town. Your recipient is revealed on Winter 18.
